title: Shameik Moore makes Breeze a standout character in 'Raising Kanan' - NewsBreak
text:
By Romeo International ,
12 hours ago Shameik Moore on 'Raising Kanan' Shameik Moore joined the final season of Raising Kanan as Breeze, one of the most iconic and enigmatic characters in the entire Power universe. As an ambitious and shrewd drug kingpin from East New York, Breeze expands his operations into South Jamaica, Queens. He takes young Kanan Stark under his wing, leading to significant changes in everyone’s lives, including his own.
LISTEN NOW: Shameik Moore on 'Raising Kanan'
Moore, renowned for his iconic roles in films like Spider-Man: Across the Spider-Verse , Dope , and Wu-Tang: An American Saga , recently sat down with Romeo International to share his insights on his approach to Breeze and the Power universe.
Is there pressure on the character Breeze when he was first introduced to you, or is there a certain way that you wanted him to come across screen?
"I didn't really know Breeze internally that much, you know what I mean? I needed to find that character. I was aware. Like, for me I need to smell that in the performances. There's no I'm killing it season one, or season two it gets better. Season three got even better. There's no evolution for me in the role like my other cast mates. I have to come in like living in my character in order to satisfy the fans. I also know the timeline and what I'm up against. I think the real pressure is I have to take advantage of every second I have on screen."
Power Book III: Raising Kanan is now streaming on Starz
